raw.details:
"AVISHKAAR Virtual Track" is an intensive 24-hour national-level online hackathon that harnesses the power of innovation and technology to address real-time challenges faced by both rural and urban communities in India.
This virtual event will be conducted entirely online via Zoom for team interactions and GitHub for submissions and project tracking.
It brings together creative minds, tech enthusiasts, and problem solvers from across the country to collaborate remotely and develop cutting-edge tech solutions that create a positive impact on society.

Objective:

  • "AVISHKAAR Virtual Track" aims to provide a fast-paced virtual innovation environment where thinkers and technology enthusiasts come together to tackle real-world problems using technology. The goal is to develop practical, impactful, and scalable tech solutions for both rural and urban India — all within a 24-hour time frame.
  • This track creates a dynamic virtual space that encourages collaboration, creativity, and problem-solving under real-time constraints — inspiring participants to drive meaningful innovation.

Hackathon Format:

  • Duration: 24 hours of continuous development
  • Mode: Completely virtual (Online)
  • Platform: Zoom (for coordination & mentoring) and GitHub (for submissions)
  • Problem Statements: Revealed at the start of the hackathon
  • Themes: Digital Empowerment, Healthcare, Agriculture, Sustainability, Urban Solutions, and Student Innovation

Prizes:

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹50,000
  • 1st Prize: ₹25,000
  • 2nd Prize: ₹15,000
  • 3rd Prize: ₹10,000

Registration & Team Guidelines:

  • Teams must register before the hackathon begins
  • Team size: 1–4 members
  • Members can be from different streams but must belong to the same college
  • All members should be available for the entire 24-hour event

Hackathon Structure:

  • Kickoff: Problem statements announced at the start
  • Development Phase: 24 hours of intensive coding and innovation
  • Submission: Teams submit projects via GitHub before the deadline
  • Evaluation: Based on innovation, feasibility, impact, and presentation

Submission Requirements:

Teams must submit:

  • GitHub repository or demo link (working prototype)
  • Project presentation/documentation
  • Short video demo
  • Technical architecture details

(Detailed submission guidelines will be shared during kickoff)

What Makes AVISHKAAR Unique:

  • Real problems revealed in real time
  • Fully online, national participation
  • 24-hour sprint for maximum innovation
  • Focus on feasible, high-impact tech solutions
  • Collaborative virtual setup using Zoom and GitHub

Preparation Tips:

  • Form your teams early
  • Ensure stable internet and required tools
  • Manage time effectively for the 24-hour sprint
  • Use proper communication channels
  • Plan rest schedules strategically
